name: layout-reroll-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `layoutReroll` (simple tier — 'Try another layout' button in the FinishPicker's Room layout section). Opens the FinishPicker for livingDining, snapshots the room's item transforms, clicks 'Try another layout' twice (asserting a distinct, collision-valid layout each time via `layoutVariants[roomId]` incrementing and item positions changing), undoes back to the original layout, then re-verifies the button is present after a Simple→Pro switch (layoutReroll is simple-tier, shown in both modes).

steps.name: verify-layoutreroll-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: layoutReroll should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: finish-picker-visible
steps.failMessage: FinishPicker (.panel.inspector) did not appear after room selection

steps.name: reroll-button-visible

waitFor.css: button[title^='Re-arrange this room into a different valid layout']

steps.failMessage: 'Try another layout' button did not render for a room with items (layoutReroll simple-tier)

steps.name: reroll-once
steps.eval: document.querySelector("button[title^='Re-arrange this room into a different valid layout']").click()

steps.name: variant-1
steps.failMessage: layoutVariants['livingDining'] should be 1 after one reroll

steps.name: layout-changed-after-reroll-1
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const before=JSON.parse(window.__baselineItems); const changed = before.some(b => { const now = s.items.find(i=>i.id===b.id); return now && (Math.abs(now.position[0]-b.p[0])>1e-4 || Math.abs(now.position[1]-b.p[1])>1e-4 || now.rotation!==b.r); }); if (!changed) throw new Error('No item moved after the first reroll'); })()

steps.name: reroll-twice
steps.eval: document.querySelector("button[title^='Re-arrange this room into a different valid layout']").click()

steps.name: variant-2
steps.failMessage: layoutVariants['livingDining'] should be 2 after a second reroll

steps.name: layout-restored

waitFor.store: (function(){ const before=JSON.parse(window.__baselineItems); return before.every(b => { const now = state.items.find(i=>i.id===b.id); return now && Math.abs(now.position[0]-b.p[0])<1e-4 && Math.abs(now.position[1]-b.p[1])<1e-4 && now.rotation===b.r; }); })()

steps.failMessage: Two undos should restore the room's original layout

steps.name: verify-layoutreroll-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: layoutReroll should still be ON in Pro mode (simple-tier flags are shown in both modes)

steps.name: reroll-still-present-in-pro

waitFor.css: button[title^='Re-arrange this room into a different valid layout']

steps.failMessage: 'Try another layout' button should still render in Pro mode
